title: Persona Contact Lists Delete — payload
description: Delete one of the holder's contact lists and take every contact off it. The contacts themselves are untouched. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: Persona Contact Lists Delete — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/contact/lists/delete. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/contact/lists/delete/1.0#response. Deleting an absent list is a success carrying existed: false, which is what makes a repeated delete converge.

contactsUpdated.description: How many contacts were taken off the list. Zero when it did not exist.
